original.target_description: Reduction in agreement that Professor Smith caused the problem, compared to prior Knobe–Fraser mean; original reported one-sample t test.

n.sample_role: students in the target original sample
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported; target test in adjacent footnote 4 has df117.
n.quote: Subjects were 118 students in an introductory philosophy class at York University.

replication.target_description: Professor causation judgment difference between Knobe–Fraser and Roxborough–Cumby vignette groups; final replication report Welch test.

n.sample_role: participants in target two-group test (102 and 104)
n.exclusions: Incomplete responses excluded under preregistered plan; target groups 102 and 104.
n.quote: the replication ended up collecting responses from 206 participants.

notes: Original requested d is not printed in original source; printed t retained without conversion. Replication report gives 206 participants and d=-0.193; authors final CSV instead gives ReplicationN_Effect=204 and d=-0.198. Report values retained, discrepancy unresolved. Replication changes design by collecting both comparison groups independently rather than comparing original responses against a previously published mean.
